mapper.select: select id from media_root where guest_visible = 0 order by id asc
select rating from media_rating_policy where guest_visible = 0 order by rating asc
select root_id from media_video where id = #{id} limit 1
select content_rating from media_video where id = #{id} limit 1
select distinct root_id from media_photo where album_id = #{albumId}
select content_rating from media_album where id = #{albumId} limit 1
select p.root_id as rootId, a.content_rating as rating from media_photo p left join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id where p.content_hash = #{hash}
select root_id from media_photo where album_id = #{albumId} and seq = #{seq} limit 1
select avatar_kind as kind, avatar_ref as ref, avatar_path as avatarPath from media_person where id = #{id} limit 1
select content_rating from media_video where rel_path = #{rel} limit 1
select a.content_rating from media_photo p inner join media_album a on a.id = p.album_id where p.rel_path = #{rel} limit 1
